text:
laura: quick alert - a bunch of tenant snapshot restores failed with `KMS PermissionDenied` after the RBAC sweep. Logs show DEK unwrap failure.
mike: paste minimal log
laura: ``
2026-04-10T07:22:11Z ERROR restore: dek unwrap: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = caller lacks cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
2026-04-10T07:22:11Z INFO snapshot=tenant-omega-20260401
``
sre-bot: IAM audit: role removal for uploader-sa@redwood-prod at 2026-04-10T07:00:02Z
hana: uploader historically performed envelope key unwrap during multipart rewrap. RBAC prune removed a broad role and the KMS key policy no longer grants decrypt to uploader-sa.
laura: mitigation: I applied a short-lived decrypt binding to the backups key for uploader-sa and retried the restore; success.
mike: ok temporary fix. longer term: move unwrap to a dedicated decryptor service running under `backup-decryptor` SA so uploader never needs KMS decrypt rights. Also add pre-merge check to diff `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` for backups keyring and run a tiny restore smoke.
hana: also recommend adding a low-noise alert for any deletion/removal from backups key IAM and a KMS-policy change playbook step: block RBAC PRs that remove known-decrypt SAs without replacement.
laura: filing ENGSEC-7010: "DEK unwrap failures after RBAC sweep; migrate unwrap to decryptor SA and add pre-merge KMS IAM diff". Revoking temp grant in 45m.

laura: thanks all. :thumbsup:
